title.narrative: NDICI STABILITY THREATS/FPI01/ACT-63015/Climate Change, Environment, Peace and Security

description.narrative: This action has three components:i)         EU-UNEP Climate change, Environment and Security Partnership This ongoing partnership is key to ensuring the FPI and broader EU approach strengthens multilateral engagement on the climate-security nexus and informs global policy development on this issue. The Partnership continues to provide much of the evidence base for EU policy development as it has developed tools and capacities since 2017 to enhance environment and climate-security analysis and preventive action to address conflict and fragility risks. The next phase will have a more defined thematic dimension, delivering science and environmental analysis to inform EU and UN conflict prevention and peacebuilding initiatives around specific issues relating to natural resource governance as well as emerging issues such as urbanisation. Knowledge management will be further strengthened to ensure that the expertise acquired through this action is disseminated i) throughout the EU and ii) in regional and international fora, including through the second component below. Geographic focus of the action will be defined at a later stage and will complement broader EU engagement, notably from DG INTPA.ii) Support to national and regional engagement on Climate Change, Peace and Security This component will strengthen partnerships at national level and above through an award to a multidisciplinary consortium of climate and environment expert organisations together with peace-building and mediation experts focusing on:-          Policy support to institutional stakeholders in key states e.g. Ministries of Environment, Security, etc;-          Regional convening processes to align national and regional processes between institutional actors and civil society platforms;-          Sub-granting mechanism with provision of technical expertise from consortium;-          Regional knowledge management facilitation to ensure that policy development is evidence-based and adapted to context.iii) Support to Climate senstive risk analysis and foresight Earth observation and analysis is a key component of foresight and anticipatory action.
